plugins.name: oracle-to-postgres-migration-advisor
plugins.description: Interview-driven Oracle to Azure PostgreSQL migration assessment. Runs a guided interview, scans Oracle source with no database connection, applies a source-backed knowledge base and a versioned rule set, and returns a provisional target, method, blockers and evidence gaps, with a rule ID behind every verdict, a prerequisite plan and a PDF report. It recommends Microsoft services and Azure-hosted offerings only; where Microsoft has no product, it says so and names none.
